I replied to Marcus in a thread on his message in #north-random. I confirmed the correction: the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. is due 15 August. I also pointed out that 15 August has already passed, since today is 14 October, and asked him to tell me if Thornbury's ops lead meant a different month or next year.

I took no other action, as he asked. I didn't look up the date he posted earlier, so I can't say what it was.
